activity.notes: The Commando Veterans Archive identifies John Malcolm Thorpe Fleming Churchill with Nos. 2, 3 and 5 Commandos and records that he was wounded during Operation Archery at Vågsøy on 27 December 1941. ATLAS records that exact source-backed combat date rather than his whole military career.
